facts.text: Once enrolled at CSU Global, your tuition rate stays the same from your first class to your last, with $0 in student fees.

sources.title: Online College Costs and Financial Aid | Colorado State University Global
sources.quote: Once enrolled at CSU Global, your tuition rate stays the same from your first class to your last. Unlike the majority of four-year accredited universities, CSU Global charges $0 in student fees
